answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The desk takes £22 per docket, and 25 dockets before the first reward is released per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. The desk only stamps a name that carries Roadbound chart maker atlas warrant, and the stamp itself rests on a warrant chart makers show after chart room trials. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Every harbor is counted once. The vine is on the docket. The umber is checked, not assumed.
